repositories.description: Clean up the AI "slop" from your text. A CLI tool that removes some tell-tale signs of LLM-generated text (curly quotes, em-dashes, and non-breaking spaces)
repositories.note: Zig 字符/标点清理 CLI，不是语义改写 skill。

repositories.description: Detect and fix AI writing patterns in Obsidian — clichés, jargon, passive voice, and more.
repositories.note: Obsidian 插件；可选改写会调用外部模型。

repositories.description: Diff-aware CI gate for AI slop: scans only the lines a PR adds for the tells that make code, prose, and UI read as AI-generated
repositories.note: PR 新增行规则门禁，非通用文章改写。
